Run Model Test and Return p-value and Statistic

Source: R/iDAS_functions.R
anova_test.Rd

Fits two models using either lm or lmer (if a random effect is provided) and performs an ANOVA to compare them. Returns the p-value and a test statistic.

Usage

anova_test(data, formula0, formula1, model_fit_function)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing the data for the models.

formula0

A character string representing the formula for the null model.

formula1

A character string representing the formula for the alternative model.

model_fit_function

A character string specifying the model fitting function to use ("lm" or "lmer").

Value

A numeric vector of length 2, where the first element is the p-value and the second element is the test statistic.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Using linear models:
run_test(data = my_data, "Y ~ x", "Y ~ x + z", model_fit_function = "lm")
} # }
